display_long_description:
Bottle Shooting Simulator – Shooting Game is a realistic and engaging shooting experience focused on accuracy, timing, and control. Step into immersive environments where your goal is simple but challenging: aim precisely and shoot bottles placed at varying distances and angles.

The game features smooth shooting mechanics, responsive controls, and physics-based bottle reactions that make every shot feel rewarding. As you progress, levels become more challenging, testing your focus and hand-eye coordination.

Designed for both casual fun and skill improvement, the simulator offers comfortable gameplay, clean visuals, and intuitive controls. Whether you want to relax with target practice or sharpen your shooting precision, Bottle Shooting Simulator delivers a satisfying shooting experience.

Key Features
🎯 Precision-Based Bottle Shooting Gameplay
🔫 Realistic Shooting Mechanics & Physics
🧠 Skill-Focused Levels with Increasing Difficulty
🕹️ Smooth & Responsive Controls
🌍 Multiple Shooting Environments
🎮 Casual-Friendly & Simulator-Style Gameplay
